application.description: Minimal reference application for common/mcap_logger: attaches HsdkMcapLogger to eight clock-triggered topics -- two single-joint isaac.JointStateCpu waveforms, a shared circular-motion isaac.PoseCpu/TwistCpu/TransformCpu, a fixed isaac.CameraInfoCpu, and the same tensor-schema holoscan.schema.Image counter stream recorded twice for comparison -- once raw at 640x480 and once as 1920x1080 hardware-encoded video with a metadata sidecar channel on a host with a usable hardware encoder, omitting the encoded topic and its sidecar where there is none -- and records them to an .mcap file for a configurable duration.

record.description: Record 10 seconds of sine_joint_state, cosine_joint_state, circular_pose, circular_twist, circular_transform, camera_info, counter_image, and counter_image_encoded, plus counter_image_encoded/metadata where the host can encode.

application.name: mcap_logger_reference
